Class LognormalPar

java.lang.Object
random.AbstractParameter
random.LognormalPar
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCheck, Parameter
public class LognormalPar extends AbstractParameter implements Parameter
This is the parameter that should be passed to the Normal distribution.

  • Constructor Details

    • LognormalPar

      public LognormalPar(double mu, double sigma) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It creates a new normal parameter according to the data provided by the user: the mean and the standard deviation of the normal distribution.
      Parameters:
      mu - double containing the mean of the normal distribution.
      sigma - double containing the standard deviation of the normal distribution.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - if the standard deviation is not greater than zero.

    • LognormalPar

      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException

  • Method Details

    • check

      public boolean check()
      It verifies that the parameter is correct. For the normal distribution, the parameter is right if the standard deviation is greater than zero.
      Specified by:
      check in interface AutoCheck
      Specified by:
      check in interface Parameter
      Overrides:
      check in class AbstractParameter
      Returns:
      boolean indicating if the parameter is correct or not.

      public void setMu(double mu) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It allows the user to change the value of the mean of the normal distribution.

    • setSigma

      public void setSigma(double sigma) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It allows the user to change the value of the standard deviation of the normal distribution and verifies if it is greater than zero.
      Parameters:
      sigma - double indicating the standard deviation of the normal distribution.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - if the standard deviation is not greater than zero.
